تستأنون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْنُونَ (tastaʔnūna) /tas.taʔ.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# تُسْتَأْنَوْنَ (tustaʔnawna) /tus.taʔ.naw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
